Removing binary canonicalisation restores either an independent reference-budget miss or distinct bit patterns under 1024 dilation; the reference is independently integrated rather than supplied to the kernel.

An unavailable scalar assembly receipt or a changed current vertical field refuses cached admission, and any residual pair beyond its derived allowance makes the final assertion fail; the stored failing census is the positive control.
An absent known grid displacement, differing canonical operands, differing packed dilation outputs, a nonfinite field or an independent reference miss refuses the census.
